title: Keep input fields and add one
summary: RunnablePassthrough.assign keeps an input dictionary and adds calculated fields. It is useful when later steps need both the original data and a summary.
introduction: RunnablePassthrough.assign keeps an input dictionary and adds calculated fields. It is useful when later steps need both the original data and a summary. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Explain keep input fields and add one
Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: RunnablePassthrough.assign keeps an input dictionary and adds calculated fields. It is useful when later steps need both the original data and a summary.

blocks.code:
from langchain_core.runnables import RunnablePassthrough
step = RunnablePassthrough.assign(length=lambda data: len(data["title"]))
print(step.invoke({"title": "Moon"}))
blocks.title: Keep input fields and add one

blocks.text: The result contains title: Moon and length: 4. The title is kept while the new length field is calculated from it.
